name: domain_agents
description: Domain Agents registry, path-router hook, parallel read-only consultation, and scenario check runner (S04E03).

validate.description: Validate all agents/<name>/ folders (agent.md, memories.md receipts, glossary.md, scenarios.md).

scenarios.description: Run scenario checks for one or all Domain Agents.

agent.description: Optional single Domain Agent name when running scenarios.

paths.description: File paths to match against Domain Agent owns: globs for parallel consultation.

live.description: Use live OpenRouter model calls (requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY) instead of deterministic local matching.
